text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka came walking from down the hallway,
looking unwell...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
I'm fine, it's just a slight headache...
choice_data_list: Do you want to rest for a while?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I think running will make me feel better.
So, taking a break is just—"

"And so, Silence Suzuka was troubled
by a headache..."
